title: 欧洲多语言评估数据集：EMT网络内的MMLU本地化项目
summary: 本文报告了翻译总局与欧洲翻译硕士网络合作，将MMLU数据集本地化为11种欧洲语言的项目。该项目不仅创建了更包容的LLM评估基准，还为学生提供了翻译、修订、项目管理和多语言协调的真实专业培训，同时突出了关键的方法、行政和工作流程挑战。
summary_en: This paper reports on a collaboration between the Directorate-General for Translation and the European Master's in Translation to localise the MMLU dataset into 11 European languages, creating a more inclusive benchmark for LLM evaluation and providing authentic professional training for students.
